snippet.title: Counting Sheep | Horror Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Separated from her new born baby, a homebound woman begins to notice odd discrepancies in both the population count and the caretaker of her only child.

A short atmospheric horror game created in 7 days solo for Scream Jam 2025

Try my game here !!
https://dastardlyfool.itch.io/counting-sheep
